name: Engraved treatise
description: Plates from an illustrated treatise: warm ink black, bone paper, one hazard-orange signal. Hairlines, engraving hatch, Swiss grid, deadpan mono annotations. (The pdoom-video look.)
idiom: Each plate borrows one technical idiom (engraving, oscilloscope, bureaucratic form, banknote guilloche, blueprint, UI) and stages the lyric inside it as a visual pun, never a literal illustration. Bone paper plates invert the rhythm. Only the signal colour glows; bone type stays crisp.
